title: Law to require warnings before building violations become tax liens
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings to warn property owners that unpaid violations could become tax liens and to notify owners within 3 days after an Environmental Control Board judgment with payment options and deadlines. It would also require the Department of Buildings and Department of Finance to publish annual data on lien conversions and conduct outreach to owners of one- and two-family homes. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
